# Koṇḍaññabuddhavaṁsa (Bv 4)

**ID:** Bv 4  
**Section:** Buddhavaṁsa (bv)  
**Collection:** Sutta  
**Title (Pali):** Koṇḍaññabuddhavaṁsa  
**tipitaka.org (CST):** [https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0511m.mul3.xml](https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0511m.mul3.xml)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Koṇḍaññabuddhavaṁsa* is the biographical section of the *Buddhavaṁsa* dedicated to the past Buddha Koṇḍañña [Gaffney 2003]. Following the account of Buddha Dīpaṅkara, it establishes a biographical schema utilized across the remaining past buddha biographies in the collection [Gaffney 2003]. The text concisely enumerates the cardinal details of Koṇḍañña's life, including his city of origin, parentage, the size of his disciple retinue, the foremost male and female disciples, his personal attendant, the species of his bodhi tree, his physical stature, and his lifespan [Gaffney 2003]. Embedded within the narrative is the account of the Bodhisatta (the future Gotama Buddha), recording the gift offered by the Bodhisatta to Koṇḍañña and Koṇḍañña's subsequent prophecy (*byākaraṇa*) confirming his future buddhahood [Gaffney 2003]. Notably, unlike most other biographies in the *Buddhavaṁsa*, the explicit resolution (*adhiṭṭhāna*) by the Bodhisatta to fulfill the ten perfections (*pāramī*) is omitted in the *Koṇḍaññabuddhavaṁsa* [Gaffney 2003].

Verses from the *Koṇḍaññabuddhavaṁsa* are directly cited and commented upon in the prose of the *Jātakanidāna* (*Jātakanidānakathā*) [Gaffney 2003].

**Sources**

- [Gaffney 2003] Sean D. Gaffney, Jātakanidānakathā: A Critical Study (2003) — Described the biographical structure of Koṇḍañña's life, the embedded bodhisatta narrative, the absence of the adhiṭṭhāna to fulfill the pāramīs, and the citation format in the Jātakanidāna.
